action_item_for_main_agent: Fix critical MongoDB ObjectId serialization issue in backend. The error 'ObjectId object is not iterable' occurs when FastAPI tries to serialize MongoDB documents containing ObjectId fields. Need to either: 1) Ensure all MongoDB queries exclude _id field with {'_id': 0}, 2) Convert ObjectId to string before returning, or 3) Use custom JSON encoder for ObjectId serialization.
